description: We are KRISHIVA 360, a team passionate about space technology, smart agriculture, innovation, and solving real-world challenges using NASA data. We welcome creative thinkers, problem-solvers, and collaborative learners. We seek members skilled in coding, AI/ML, data analysis, IoT, agriculture, research, and design. Join us to share ideas, learn together, and develop innovative solutions for sustainable agriculture.
summary:
KRISHIVA 360 – AI–IoT Enabled Smart Agriculture & Intelligent Optimization System

KRISHIVA 360 is an integrated smart agriculture ecosystem that combines Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), NASA Earth observation datasets, and Quantum Computing to support sustainable and data-driven farming. The project addresses challenges such as soil nutrient deficiencies, crop selection uncertainty, inefficient water utilization, unpredictable weather conditions, and pest-related agricultural losses.

The system integrates a portable Smart Soil-Nutrition Probe to measure soil moisture, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, pH, and temperature. NASA datasets, including POWER, SMAP, GPM IMERG, and Landsat 8/9, provide additional environmental and satellite-derived information. An AI Decision Engine analyses these inputs to generate crop suitability recommendations, irrigation guidance, and nutrient management suggestions.

A key innovation is the integration of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) through a hybrid quantum-classical optimization approach to explore agricultural resource allocation and crop optimization problems. Additionally, an Adaptive Solar Pest Lamp supports pest monitoring, while the KRISHIVA mobile application aims to make agricultural intelligence accessible to farmers.

Our vision is to connect space technology, AI, IoT, and quantum computing to empower farmers, improve resource utilization, and promote sustainable agriculture.
details: KRISHIVA 360 is an AI and IoT-enabled smart agriculture ecosystem that integrates NASA Earth observation data, soil sensing technology, artificial intelligence, and quantum optimization to support intelligent agricultural decision-making. The system consists of six major modules. First, a portable Smart Soil-Nutrition Probe measures soil moisture, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, pH, and temperature. Second, NASA datasets such as NASA POWER, SMAP, GPM IMERG, and Landsat 8/9 provide environmental and satellite-derived information. Third, an AI Decision Engine analyses soil, weather, crop requirements, and agricultural information to generate crop suitability recommendations, irrigation guidance, and nutrient management suggestions. A major innovation is our Quantum Optimization Engine, which integrates the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) through a hybrid quantum-classical approach to explore agricultural optimization problems, including crop selection and efficient resource allocation. The system also includes an Adaptive Solar Pest Lamp for pest monitoring and a KRISHIVA mobile application to make agricultural intelligence accessible to farmers. The project combines technologies such as ESP32-based IoT hardware, soil sensors, NASA open-source datasets, AI-based data processing, quantum computing, and mobile application development. KRISHIVA 360 is creative because it connects ground-level soil intelligence with space-based environmental observations and quantum-assisted optimization within one agricultural ecosystem. Our intended impact is to support informed farming decisions, improve water and nutrient utilization, reduce agricultural resource wastage, and promote sustainable, climate-aware agriculture. Our development considers affordability, accessibility, scalability, environmental sustainability, and practical benefits for farmers.
